tasks.short: Check payment requests, record the decision and approve spending within my authority.

today.trigger: A payment request or invoice arrives for controller approval.
steps: Collect the request, invoice, budget code and evidence of receipt.
Check the supplier, amount, possible duplicates and approval authority.
Ask the requester or bookkeeper to resolve missing information.
Approve or reject the expenditure and record the reason.
Pass approved items into the payment process with separate bank authorization.
drudgery: Repeated checks of limits and budget codes
today.time_sinks: Missing evidence and unclear approval ownership cause repeated handoffs between sites, finance and requesters.

lenses.faster: Validate required fields, duplicates and approval limits automatically. Present one evidence pack so I only investigate exceptions and judge the expenditure.
lenses.autonomous: An AFAS workflow checks each submitted request and routes it under the approved authority matrix. Routine checks run without reminders; payment release follows the bank mandate.
lenses.ambitious: Check every request for split purchases, repeated exceptions and unusual supplier changes. Use the findings to improve purchasing controls across all three sites.
lenses.joy: Remove attachment hunting and approval chasing. Keep the conversations about whether spending is justified and how to prevent recurring problems.
lenses.options: For a problematic request, show rejection, correction, deferral and escalation options with their cash and operational consequences.
lenses.altitude: I maintain the approval rules, review exceptions and test whether the control system catches real errors.
reach: Bookkeeper: resolve recurring invoice intake problems
Accountant: test purchasing controls and preserve approval evidence
Finance Director: propose changes to delegated spending limits

tasks.human_edge: Judging commercial necessity, conflicts of interest and exceptions remains a human responsibility. Spending approval and bank release must remain separate where policy requires it.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate fits document collection, validation and exception routing before controller approval. deterministic_software handles limits and duplicate checks; an llm_step can extract document fields for validation.

in_practice.trigger: A request enters the AFAS approval queue.
steps: Extract request fields and attach links to the original evidence.
Run deterministic completeness, duplicate, budget and authority checks.
Route missing information to the requester and flag supplier bank changes for independent verification.
Present the controller with the proposed decision and failed checks.
Record the approved decision in AFAS and pass eligible items to the separate payment workflow.
in_practice.human_gate: The controller approves expenditure within delegated authority; higher amounts go to the Finance Director. Rabobank release requires the authorized signatories.
data_needed: Approval matrix and spending policy
Supplier master data and change history
Invoice and receipt evidence
Budget availability and existing commitments
Prior invoices and payment status
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS approval history, with evidence references and validation results in a restricted SharePoint control register.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit supports purchasing invoice processing and approval workflows; the available configuration must be checked.
The proposed document extraction and exception workflow could reduce controller handling effort by about 60%; this is an untested estimate.

risks: False duplicate matches or incorrect extracted amounts block legitimate payments.
A changed supplier bank account could enable payment fraud if verification is automated away.
Combining requester, approver and bank release permissions defeats segregation of duties.
Document content could manipulate an AI step unless documents are treated only as input data.
research_questions: What proportion of requests is complete on arrival, and how many minutes does each approval take?
Can the AFAS configuration expose documents, workflow status and approval limits with a usable audit history?
Which spending exceptions require controller judgment, and which checks can be expressed as fixed rules?
How are supplier bank changes and Rabobank signatory separation verified today?

tasks.short: Watch cash, liquidity headroom and financial obligations, and escalate problems before deadlines.

today.trigger: The daily cash review, a approaching filing deadline or a significant financial movement.
steps: Collect bank balances, receivables, payables and upcoming payroll and tax payments.
Update the cash outlook and compare available liquidity with agreed thresholds.
Check the financial compliance calendar and any financing conditions.
Investigate gaps, unusual movements and missing evidence.
Escalate breaches and record actions with named owners.
drudgery: Separating real exceptions from timing differences
today.time_sinks: Reconciling fresh bank information with the nightly AFAS extract and chasing explanations for large movements.

lenses.faster: Combine bank movements, AFAS obligations and a controlled deadline register into one exception view. Routine reconciliation and threshold checking disappear from my daily review.
lenses.autonomous: Scheduled checks flag liquidity shortfalls, overdue obligations and missing evidence. Stale or incomplete feeds produce an explicit data warning.
lenses.ambitious: Monitor liquidity and financial obligations daily across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo. Detect forecast drift early enough to change collections or payment timing.
lenses.joy: Replace balance copying and calendar maintenance with investigation of meaningful changes and early conversations with the business.
lenses.options: Show cash outcomes for late customer receipts, peak agency invoices and higher payroll costs, with explicit assumptions.
lenses.altitude: I define thresholds, verify coverage and improve how quickly each alert leads to an effective response.
reach: Credit and Collections Officer: prioritize cash-critical receivables
FP&A Analyst: maintain short-term cash forecast drivers
Accountant: maintain evidence for financial compliance checks

tasks.human_edge: The controller interprets financing terms and legal obligations with appropriate advisers, judges materiality and owns escalation. Monitoring cannot establish compliance with every law.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software can calculate balances, thresholds and deadline status from controlled data. An optional llm_step drafts explanations from verified exceptions; legal interpretation remains human.

in_practice.trigger: Bank or AFAS data becomes available, or a compliance deadline approaches.
steps: Import balances and obligations through authorized interfaces and mark each source timestamp.
Reconcile opening balances, movements and closing balances; stop dependent checks when data is incomplete.
Calculate liquidity headroom and check approved financial obligations and deadlines.
Create ranked alerts with source evidence, an owner and a due date.
Track resolution and escalate unresolved material exceptions.
in_practice.human_gate: Routine monitoring runs automatically. The controller validates material alerts; the Finance Director approves funding or policy responses, and specialists resolve legal uncertainty.
data_needed: Authorized bank feeds and balances
Receivable and payable due dates
Payroll, tax and agency payment schedules
Credit facilities and contractual headroom definitions, if applicable
Reviewed compliance calendar and escalation thresholds
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted SharePoint financial control register, with source timestamps and alert resolution history; Power BI displays status.

evidence.claim: Power BI supports scheduled refresh and financial monitoring dashboards, subject to source, licensing and refresh constraints.
Deterministic checks can compare cash balances, contractual thresholds and deadlines when their definitions are explicit.
The estimated 55% handling-time saving depends on feed access and the number of genuine exceptions.

risks: A nightly extract can conceal a same-day liquidity problem.
Incomplete obligations or incorrect contractual definitions produce false reassurance.
Too many low-value alerts cause important warnings to be ignored.
Automated commentary could present an uncertain legal interpretation as a fact.
research_questions: How fresh can authorized Rabobank and AFAS data be, and how are failed imports detected?
Which financial obligations and financing conditions have documented owners and testable definitions?
How often have liquidity or filing problems been discovered late?
What alert volume can the controller handle without delaying material responses?

tasks.short: Recommend how to fund cash needs and use temporary surpluses.

today.trigger: The cash forecast shows a funding gap or surplus, or management considers a significant investment.
steps: Collect expected receipts, payments, seasonal volumes and planned investments.
Build funding and surplus forecasts in Excel.
Check available facilities, terms and permitted uses of cash.
Compare funding or deposit options and stress the assumptions.
Recommend an action to the Finance Director with costs and risks.
today.time_sinks: Reconciling assumptions from collections, payroll, agency spending and site investment plans.

lenses.faster: Populate a controlled cash model automatically and draft a recommendation from its checked outputs. I spend time challenging assumptions and comparing financing choices.
lenses.autonomous: A projected shortfall or surplus triggers a scenario pack. Borrowing, deposits and investment commitments still require authorized decisions.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain a rolling 13-week cash forecast with longer-term investment scenarios. Measure forecast bias by driver and improve it after each cycle.
lenses.joy: Remove spreadsheet assembly and repeated arithmetic. Keep the judgment about resilience, cost and operational priorities.
lenses.options: Compare drawing a facility, improving collections, deferring discretionary spending and retaining or depositing cash under approved policy.
lenses.altitude: I design the cash decision framework and test whether its recommendations remain sound under adverse conditions.
reach: FP&A Analyst: model working capital and investment scenarios
Credit and Collections Officer: identify receipts that materially affect funding needs
Finance Director: prepare bank discussion materials

tasks.human_edge: Choosing financing involves risk appetite, lender relationships and uncertain business commitments. The controller challenges the model and recommends; authorized management commits funds.
tasks.pattern_why: copilot fits assumption testing and recommendation drafting while the controller leads the decision. deterministic_software should perform the financial calculations and enforce policy constraints.

in_practice.trigger: The rolling forecast crosses an approved headroom threshold or management requests a funding assessment.
steps: Populate the cash model from reconciled financial data and approved operational assumptions.
Calculate base, downside and recovery scenarios with a versioned calculation engine.
Compare only current, verified financing or deposit terms allowed by treasury policy.
Draft a recommendation showing liquidity effects, costs, assumptions and unresolved questions.
Have the controller challenge the pack and submit the final recommendation to the Finance Director.
in_practice.human_gate: The controller approves the analysis; the Finance Director and bank-authorized signatories approve commitments within their mandates.
data_needed: Customer payment behavior and receivables
Supplier, payroll, tax and staffing agency payment schedules
Seasonal demand and investment assumptions
Verified financing and deposit terms
Treasury policy and minimum liquidity requirements
in_practice.logs_to: Versioned SharePoint forecast and decision files containing inputs, scenarios, controller changes and management approval.

evidence.claim: Microsoft Excel supports financial models and sensitivity analysis using structured inputs.
An assistant can draft a funding comparison from checked model outputs, but cannot establish that the assumptions or available terms are suitable.
The estimated 45% effort saving and 1.5 times end-to-end speedup require a pilot.

risks: Incorrect receipt timing can materially understate funding needs.
Stale rates or facility terms distort the recommendation.
Scenarios may omit simultaneous shocks such as late customer receipts and peak agency costs.
A fluent recommendation may hide weak assumptions or concentration risk.
research_questions: How accurate are current cash forecasts at one, four and thirteen weeks?
Which financing and surplus instruments are actually permitted and available?
Can forecast inputs distinguish committed payments from estimates?
How much time is spent assembling data versus challenging and negotiating the decision?

tasks.short: Run the planning cycle and align site budgets, purchasing and investment decisions.

today.trigger: A budget or forecast cycle begins, or a purchasing or investment decision needs cross-site coordination.
steps: Agree the planning calendar, assumptions and responsibilities with the Finance Director and FP&A.
Request site inputs and check their completeness.
Reconcile submissions and identify conflicting assumptions or priorities.
Discuss trade-offs with site managers and finance colleagues.
Obtain decisions, assign actions and track completion.
today.time_sinks: Late site inputs and unresolved disagreements create additional planning rounds.

lenses.faster: Use standard submissions, automatic validation and a current decision log. Preparation and follow-up shrink while discussions focus on the unresolved choices.
lenses.autonomous: The planning calendar opens input requests, checks submissions and sends internal workflow reminders to assigned owners.
lenses.ambitious: Run lighter rolling forecasts and compare site assumptions consistently. Track whether approved investments deliver their promised operational and financial results.
lenses.joy: Remove version chasing and administrative follow-up. Keep constructive discussion with site managers about priorities and constraints.
lenses.options: Prepare alternative plans for peak season, agency availability and investment timing, showing cost, capacity and cash consequences.
lenses.altitude: I own the planning process, assumption standards and decision quality while FP&A and site owners maintain their inputs.
reach: FP&A Analyst: standardize site planning assumptions
Finance Director: coordinate investment review packs
Site management: facilitate capacity and spending trade-offs

tasks.human_edge: Getting people to commit to a plan requires trust, negotiation and awareness of operational constraints. Material workforce changes need HR involvement and OR consultation or consent where legally required.
tasks.pattern_why: copilot supports briefing, comparison and action tracking, but coordinating and directing people remains with the controller. deterministic_software manages calendars, validations and workflow status.

in_practice.trigger: An approved planning milestone starts or a material investment proposal enters review.
steps: Publish controlled assumptions, templates, owners and deadlines.
Collect submissions and run deterministic completeness and consistency checks.
Draft a comparison of site proposals and highlight unresolved decisions.
Have the controller lead the review and agree actions with the relevant managers.
Record approved decisions and track delivery against the agreed plan.
in_practice.human_gate: The controller leads trade-offs and confirms actions; the Finance Director approves budgets and investments within governance rules.
data_needed: Planning calendar and responsibility matrix
Site budgets, actuals and approved forecast drivers
Purchasing commitments and investment proposals
Capacity and seasonal staffing assumptions
Decision authority and relevant HR or OR requirements
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint planning workspace with versioned submissions, decisions, owners and action status.

evidence.claim: Microsoft 365 provides shared files, collaboration and workflow components that can support a controlled planning process.
evidence.source: Microsoft SharePoint, Teams and Power Automate

evidence.claim: An assistant can compare submissions and draft briefings, while agreement on priorities remains a management task.
The proposed 30% effort saving is an untested estimate; management availability limits elapsed-time gains.

risks: Standard templates can hide genuine differences between sites.
Automated reminders may multiply messages without resolving ownership problems.
Generated actions may misrepresent what managers agreed.
Workforce proposals may overlook CAO obligations or applicable OR rights.
research_questions: Which planning rounds are delayed by administration, and which by unresolved decisions?
Where does controller ownership end and FP&A ownership begin?
Can the three sites agree common driver definitions and submission rules?
Which planning decisions require HR review or formal OR involvement?

tasks.short: Advise management on financial goals and the actions needed to meet them.

today.trigger: Management requests advice, results diverge from plan or a strategic decision is approaching.
steps: Clarify the decision, timeframe and financial objectives.
Collect actuals, forecasts and operational explanations.
Assess options and test important assumptions.
Prepare a recommendation with financial and operational consequences.
Discuss the advice with management and agree follow-up measures.
today.time_sinks: Reconciling competing explanations and translating financial analysis into decisions managers can act on.

lenses.faster: Draft a source-linked briefing from approved financial data and scenario outputs. I focus on the recommendation, its weak points and the management conversation.
lenses.autonomous: Material deviations trigger a draft briefing and a list of questions for operational owners. Advice reaches management after controller review.
lenses.ambitious: Evaluate more decisions before money is committed and revisit outcomes afterward. Connect faster closing and forecast accuracy to decisions the business actually makes.
lenses.joy: Reduce slide production and repeated data preparation. Keep explaining trade-offs, challenging assumptions and helping managers decide.
lenses.options: Show several feasible actions, their cash and profit effects, and what evidence would change the recommendation.
lenses.altitude: I build a repeatable financial decision process and coach managers to use it well.
reach: FP&A Analyst: connect variance analysis to operational actions
Finance Director: prepare strategic financial recommendations
HR Business Partner: assess aggregate workforce cost implications

tasks.human_edge: Advice depends on knowing which assumptions management can deliver, handling disagreement and taking responsibility for a recommendation under uncertainty.
tasks.pattern_why: copilot supports evidence gathering, option development and rehearsal. The controller remains responsible for interpreting the business situation and advising management.

in_practice.trigger: A management question or an approved material-variance threshold opens an advisory case.
steps: Define the decision, objectives, constraints and evidence required.
Retrieve approved actuals and forecasts with source dates and definitions.
Calculate alternative actions using controlled models and draft their implications.
Have the controller challenge assumptions with operational owners and finalize the advice.
Record the management decision and schedule a review of its outcome.
in_practice.human_gate: The controller approves every recommendation; management owns the business decision and applicable policy changes.
data_needed: Reconciled actuals and approved forecasts
Decision objectives and management constraints
Operational drivers and owner explanations
Relevant financial, workforce and purchasing policies
Outcomes from earlier comparable decisions
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted SharePoint decision register linking the final advice, assumptions, management decision and outcome review.

evidence.claim: Language models can draft briefings and alternative arguments from supplied evidence, with human verification.
The proposed 35% effort saving is an estimate; the quality and availability of operational evidence will determine the result.

risks: A convincing narrative may attribute a variance to an unsupported cause.
Management may mistake a scenario for a reliable prediction.
Cost-only advice may overlook service quality, safety or workforce consequences.
Sensitive financial or personnel information could reach an unauthorized audience.
research_questions: Which recurring management decisions consume the most controller preparation time?
Can major variance explanations be supported by operational evidence rather than opinion?
How will management judge whether faster advice improves decisions?
Which assumptions and recommendations require Finance Director, HR or OR involvement?

tasks.short: Control insurance and benefits costs, check coverage and budget employer obligations with HR.

today.trigger: An insurance renewal, benefits change, budget cycle or significant claim affects employer costs.
steps: Collect policy schedules, premiums, claims summaries and aggregate workforce data.
Confirm coverage and cost responsibilities with HR, payroll and the insurance adviser.
Budget premiums, benefits and relevant employer absence or disability costs.
Assess proposed changes against contracts, applicable CAOs and Dutch requirements.
Recommend changes and reconcile approved charges or recoveries in AFAS.
today.time_sinks: Clarifying policy wording, reconciling workforce assumptions and assigning responsibility between finance, HR and advisers.

lenses.faster: Extract renewal terms into a checked comparison and calculate costs from aggregate workforce assumptions. I review coverage gaps and material changes with HR and the adviser.
lenses.autonomous: Renewal dates and invoice arrivals trigger preparation and reconciliation checks. Regulatory updates enter a review queue before changing any budget or policy.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain a complete view of employer insurance, benefits and absence-related financial exposure across all sites. Model peak staffing and renewal shocks before negotiations.
lenses.joy: Remove policy copying and premium reconciliation. Keep the work of improving coverage and making costs understandable.
lenses.options: Compare coverage, deductibles and service options using equivalent exposure assumptions and verified insurer terms.
lenses.altitude: I own financial assurance of benefits and insurance, with HR owning employment policy and individual cases.
reach: Compensation and Benefits Specialist: compare benefit costs and renewal options
Payroll Specialist: reconcile employer charges and deductions
HR Director: prepare financial evidence for policy and OR discussions

tasks.human_edge: Coverage interpretation and employment obligations need HR and specialist advice. Dutch employer wage-continuation and WIA-related exposure must be assessed on their own terms, rather than using US workers' compensation assumptions.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate fits collecting policy documents, extracting terms and preparing cost comparisons for specialist review. deterministic_software calculates budgets; an llm_step identifies clauses without deciding their legal effect.

in_practice.trigger: A renewal deadline, insurer invoice or reviewed change notice enters the finance-HR workflow.
steps: Retrieve policies, approved benefits rules and minimum necessary aggregate workforce data.
Extract terms with document references and calculate premiums and budget scenarios deterministically.
Flag missing coverage, inconsistent charges and possible CAO or regulatory implications.
Have the controller, HR owner and insurance adviser verify the comparison and recommendation.
Record approvals and reconcile resulting invoices, recoveries and budget changes.
in_practice.human_gate: The controller validates financial effects; HR and specialist advisers validate employment and coverage implications. Authorized management approves changes, with OR involvement where required.
data_needed: Policy schedules, renewal terms and premium invoices
Approved benefits rules and applicable CAO provisions
Aggregate headcount, insured payroll and absence cost assumptions
Claims and recovery totals without unnecessary health information
Reviewed employer obligations and policy approval requirements
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted SharePoint insurance and benefits register; approved financial entries and reconciliations remain in AFAS.

evidence.claim: Document extraction and deterministic cost models can support insurance comparisons, provided experts verify policy meaning.
Dutch employer absence costs and reintegration obligations require coordination with HR; financial analysis does not replace Wet verbetering poortwachter case management.
The proposed 40% effort saving is speculative until actual policy documents and ownership are assessed.

risks: Misread exclusions or deductibles could leave important exposure uninsured.
Medical information could enter finance workflows unnecessarily, breaching AVG/GDPR requirements.
Incorrect CAO or employer-obligation assumptions could understate costs.
Agency worker responsibilities may be confused with those for Noordhaven employees.
Individual employment or benefit decisions would require a separate assessment of applicable EU AI Act requirements.
research_questions: Which insurance and benefits duties actually sit with the controller rather than HR or the adviser?
Are policy schedules and renewal terms complete, current and available in searchable form?
Can the budget be built from aggregate data without diagnoses or individual case files?
Which proposed policy changes require CAO checks, employee agreement or OR involvement?

tasks.short: Check payroll deductions and reconcile them to the ledger and payments with the payroll specialist.

today.trigger: A payroll run or correction is ready for financial control.
steps: Receive deduction totals and change reports from the Payroll Specialist.
Check tax, pension and other deductions against approved payroll rules and source changes.
Investigate unusual movements, negative amounts and corrections.
Reconcile deduction liabilities to payroll journals and settlement amounts.
Sign off the control review and route corrections to the Payroll Specialist.
today.time_sinks: Explaining exceptions and corrections across payroll periods; routine calculation should already be handled by AFAS.

lenses.faster: Use AFAS calculations and automatic reconciliations to produce an exception report. I review changes and mismatches rather than recomputing routine deductions.
lenses.autonomous: Every test payroll run triggers reconciliations and approved variance checks. Failed checks stop financial sign-off until the Payroll Specialist resolves them.
lenses.ambitious: Check every payroll run and correction consistently, including the correct transport or warehouse CAO configuration. Track recurring causes of payroll-related close adjustments.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive control totals and report comparisons. Keep solving unusual cases with payroll and improving the controls.
lenses.options: For an exception, compare correction in the current run, a supplementary run or a later period where legally and operationally permitted.
lenses.altitude: I maintain payroll-to-ledger assurance and monitor whether rule changes were tested correctly.
reach: Payroll Specialist: automate financial reconciliations and exception preparation
Accountant: reconcile payroll liabilities and clearing accounts
Compensation and Benefits Specialist: verify financial effects of approved deduction changes

tasks.human_edge: Payroll specialists interpret individual payroll cases and apply approved changes. The controller provides independent financial review; deduction calculations must use maintained payroll rules rather than a language model.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software fits statutory and approved contractual calculations, reconciliations and repeatable checks. A model may summarize exceptions, but must not calculate or invent deduction rules.

in_practice.trigger: The Payroll Specialist completes a test run or payroll correction in AFAS.
steps: Read payroll totals, approved changes and the version of the configured rules.
Reconcile deductions to payroll journals, liability accounts and expected settlements.
Run approved checks for material changes, missing mappings and unresolved prior balances.
Send exceptions to the Payroll Specialist and rerun checks after corrections.
Present the controller with the final control evidence for sign-off.
in_practice.human_gate: The Payroll Specialist resolves payroll exceptions; the controller approves the financial reconciliation. Payroll release and bank payments follow separate authorized workflows.
data_needed: Payroll runs and deduction totals
Approved tax, pension, CAO and other deduction configurations
Approved employee changes and correction history
Payroll-to-ledger mappings and liability balances
Settlement schedules and payment evidence
in_practice.logs_to: AFAS payroll and ledger records, with restricted SharePoint reconciliation evidence, exception resolution and controller sign-off.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit includes payroll calculation and financial accounting capabilities; automation here should extend existing software controls.
Deterministic reconciliation can compare payroll deductions, journal entries and liability settlements.
The 65% saving applies to the controller's remaining review effort and is untested; it excludes payroll work already automated in AFAS.

risks: Incorrect rule configuration produces consistent but wrong calculations.
The transport and warehouse CAOs may be applied to the wrong employee populations.
Retroactive corrections can create misleading variance alerts or settlement mismatches.
Payroll data requires strict role-based access under AVG/GDPR.
Agency invoices and hours could be wrongly treated as Noordhaven employee payroll.
research_questions: How much of the stated task is controller review versus calculation already performed by AFAS and payroll?
Are deduction rules, CAO assignments and ledger mappings maintained and independently tested?
Which reconciliation exceptions recur, and how material are they?
Can control reports use aggregate totals, with individual details restricted to justified exceptions?

tasks.short: Prepare and review the financial reporting pack, forecasts and required submissions.

today.trigger: A month-end close, annual reporting deadline or approved forecast cycle.
steps: Confirm the reporting scope, deadlines and responsibilities with accountants and FP&A.
Collect ledger balances, reconciliations and approved forecast or budget inputs.
Resolve missing entries, mapping issues and unexplained movements.
Prepare financial statements, reporting schedules and management commentary.
Review the pack, obtain required approval and arrange controlled distribution or filing.
drudgery: Formatting packs and chasing supporting schedules
today.time_sinks: Waiting for reconciliations and journals, checking report versions and rewriting unsupported variance explanations.

lenses.faster: Populate approved templates from a versioned ledger snapshot and automate cross-checks. Draft commentary from verified variances so I review exceptions and judgments.
lenses.autonomous: Completed close milestones trigger report assembly and validation. A pack becomes final only after reconciliations and human approvals are complete.
lenses.ambitious: Produce earlier provisional views, consistent site reporting and better forecast explanations. Measure whether faster reporting reduces close days without increasing audit adjustments.
lenses.joy: Remove copying and formatting. Keep understanding results, judging accounting treatments and explaining what changed.
lenses.options: Create management, site and statutory views from the same controlled numbers, with clearly labeled forecast scenarios.
lenses.altitude: I design reporting standards, close controls and quality checks while accountants own reconciliations and FP&A owns forecast inputs.
reach: Accountant: standardize supporting schedules and reporting mappings
FP&A Analyst: connect approved forecasts to management reporting
Finance Director: prepare approval and audit discussion packs

tasks.human_edge: Accounting judgments, material estimates, going-concern assessments and final approval require accountable professionals. Faster pack production cannot replace unfinished close work.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate fits gathering schedules, validating reports and drafting commentary before approval. deterministic_software produces totals and statements; llm_step drafts explanations only from verified evidence.

in_practice.trigger: Required close milestones are complete or an explicitly provisional reporting snapshot is authorized.
steps: Freeze a dated ledger snapshot and gather approved reconciliations and forecast versions.
Generate statements and schedules using controlled mappings and reporting templates.
Run balance, cross-report, completeness and prior-period checks; block finalization on unresolved failures.
Draft source-linked commentary and mark explanations lacking evidence.
Have the controller review judgments and obtain Finance Director approval before final distribution or filing.
in_practice.human_gate: The controller verifies the reporting pack and accounting judgments; the Finance Director approves final release. Statutory approval and filing follow the applicable governance process.
data_needed: Versioned trial balance and reporting mappings
Completed reconciliations, journals and close checklist
Approved budget and forecast versions
Reporting policies and applicable Dutch statutory requirements
Supported variance explanations and approval authority
in_practice.logs_to: SharePoint close archive containing input versions, validation results, commentary sources, review changes and final approvals; journals remain in AFAS.

evidence.claim: AFAS Profit provides financial accounting data, and Power BI supports reporting from structured extracts.
evidence.source: AFAS Profit and Microsoft Power BI

evidence.claim: Template generation and deterministic cross-checks can automate recurring report assembly; accounting judgment still requires review.
The estimated 60% controller effort saving does not imply an equivalent reduction in company close days.

risks: The nightly Power BI extract may omit the latest close journals.
Incorrect mappings propagate errors into several reports at once.
Generated commentary can invent causal explanations for valid numerical variances.
Premature finalization conceals unresolved reconciliations or accounting judgments.
The 51.7-hour allocation may understate the actual breadth of reporting responsibility.
research_questions: Which reporting outputs are included in these hours, and which belong to accountants or FP&A?
What currently determines the final close day: report assembly, reconciliations, journals or approvals?
Can reports use a controlled post-close snapshot rather than an unmarked nightly extract?
What validation failures or audit adjustments would demonstrate that the proposed workflow is unsafe?

role.altitude: The controller becomes the owner of financial control quality: reliable inputs, explicit rules, useful exceptions and decisions supported by evidence.
reach: Accountants: coordinate close dependencies and strengthen reconciliation evidence
Bookkeepers: improve invoice intake and approval controls
Credit and Collections Officer: connect collection priorities to liquidity exposure
FP&A Analysts: improve cash assumptions and test forecast bias
Payroll and Compensation and Benefits specialists: provide independent financial assurance
Finance Director: prepare funding, investment and policy decisions
role.ceiling_note: These eight tasks cover about 725 hours annually, around 45% of a 1,600-hour role. The estimates suggest roughly 360 hours of gross capacity, worth about EUR 34,000 at EUR 95/hour before implementation and ongoing oversight; they are not measured savings or a headcount reduction. Remaining duties are unassessed, overlapping workflows must not be counted twice, and judgment, approvals and management availability limit elapsed-time gains. Current workflows are inferred from the fictional company description and need validation.
skills_to_grow: Translate policies and financial controls into testable rules
Understand AFAS data, interfaces, permissions and reconciliation design
Build and challenge cash and forecast models
Evaluate AI drafts against source evidence and calculation results
Manage exception thresholds, control testing and audit trails
Apply AVG/GDPR data minimization and assess EU AI Act obligations where employment-related uses arise
Work with HR on CAO obligations and applicable OR rights
Lead decision conversations and challenge operational assumptions
role.ambitious_version: Run a continuous financial control process across all three sites, with daily liquidity exceptions, a rolling cash forecast and a close pack assembled from reconciled data. Use released capacity to challenge forecast drivers and investment outcomes, measuring success through fewer close days, trusted forecasts, lower DSO, more invoices processed without touch and fewer audit adjustments. Establish baseline measures and pilot one workflow before extending it.
